svg.title: People operations: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#235)
svg.desc: The employee management epic drew a line, “directory, not HR system”, and this epic crosses it on purpose. It adds an HR role, employment type and documents and an org chart on the record, leave with balances, holidays and a calendar, and onboarding, attendance, reviews and 1:1 notes over a person’s time with the organisation.
svg.text: People operations: how the pieces fit
· an HR role, leave, and the employee record

svg.text: A third visibility model, between the directory, which anyone signed in can read, and money, which almost nobody can.
Each keeps its own response schemas.

g.text: two first, then leave, then the rest

svg.text: first: everything else needs to know
who HR is and who is an employee
The employee record is read by the person, their manager chain and HR admins, which is a third model between the directory and money. A manager decides their reports’ leave
and gains no other authority. Still not here: recruiting, benefits, tax filings, and monitoring of what people do on their computers. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #246
